card.name: Inside Allogeneic and similar rare words
card.fires_on: The piece 'log' (or similar) in 'Allogeneic' after 'Al', mostly in transplant headings such as 'Complications of Allogeneic HSCT'. Also fires on a few other odd partial words, like 'G' in PDGFRb.

modes.label: Other split rare words
modes.description: Odd partway pieces of names or gene terms, such as PDGFRb or a name.
modes.example: Determine PD<<G>>FRb gene rearrangements status prior

card.writes: It promotes word starts like 'lobal', 'roup' and 'eneral', so it does not clearly point to the next piece.
card.plain: It marks the middle of the word Allogeneic, as in allogeneic stem cell transplant headings.
